guide.text: Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Deathstroke casts his Ultimate. His Ultimate delivers multiple hits, dealing massive damage to a single target, and with high Crit Rate and Crit Damage, he can maximize his damage and deliver devastating blows, especially when striking from behind the enemy with the highest Attack.

Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Green Arrow casts his Ultimate. His Ultimate hits a single target hard, and with his passive Crit Rate boost, he can deal devastating damage.

Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Luthor casts his Ultimate. Since his Ultimate deals AoE damage to an entire row of enemies, a higher Crit Rate lets him land multiple critical hits during the attack, making the area damage deadlier.
Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, making it the perfect fit for Robin's multi-hit, crit-driven burst attacks.

Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Red Hood casts his Ultimate. Red Hood relies on Crit Damage from his basic attacks to trigger grenade throws and deal AoE damage, and the T-Sphere Weakness Analyzer greatly boosts his Crit Rate and damage.

Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Nightwing casts his Ultimate. Defeating a target with his Ultimate lets Nightwing strike again, and with the T-Sphere Weakness Analyzer stacking Crit Damage, his consecutive strikes become even more lethal.

Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Ra's al Ghul casts his Ultimate. Since both his Ultimate and basic attacks sacrifice HP to deal more damage, a higher Crit Rate makes his burst even deadlier.

Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, and grants an additional Crit Damage bonus when Talia al Ghul casts her Ultimate. Since her Ultimate sacrifices HP to deal AoE damage, a higher Crit Rate makes her burst even deadlier.

Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to grant extra Physical Penetration. As a single-target physical burst attacker, Wally relies on stacking Speed Force and crits. The Speed Metal Suit enhances both his Ultimate and basic attack burst potential.
Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, helping Red Hood Knightfight trigger his AoE basic attacks more reliably and maintain a steady burst cycle.
